blocks.en: Hello, my name is Elena.
I am 32 years old.

blocks.es: Esta es mi semana en Madrid.
blocks.en: This is my week in Madrid.
Today is Monday.

blocks.es: Son las ocho y media de la mañana.
blocks.en: It is half past eight in the morning.
I have just moved to Madrid.
I am in my small flat.

blocks.es: Hay una maleta y dos cajas.
blocks.en: There is a suitcase and two boxes.
I take out a green plant.

blocks.es: Estoy un poco nerviosa, pero también contenta.
blocks.en: I am a little nervous, but also happy.
A new week begins.

blocks.es: A las diez voy a la [[panaderia|panadería]] del barrio.
blocks.en: At ten, I go to the neighbourhood bakery.
I buy a baguette.

blocks.es: Conozco mi barrio poco a poco.
blocks.en: I get to know my neighbourhood little by little.
The bread smells so good.
Today is Tuesday.
It is half past eight.
I have breakfast at home.
I eat bread and drink coffee.

blocks.es: La planta está en la mesa.
blocks.en: The plant is on the table.
I start my routine.

blocks.es: Por la tarde, a las dos, [[caminar|camino]] al trabajo.
blocks.en: In the afternoon, at two, I walk to work.

blocks.es: Voy a un espacio compartido cerca de casa.
blocks.en: I go to a shared workspace near home.

blocks.es: La calle ya me parece familiar.
blocks.en: The street already feels familiar.
I walk with my brown bag.
Today is Wednesday.
It is 10 in the morning.
I work on the computer.
I drink a glass of water.
I am focused.

blocks.es: El nuevo espacio ya no es tan nuevo.
blocks.en: The new space doesn't feel so new any more.

blocks.es: Por la tarde, a las 4, voy al [[parque|parque]].
blocks.en: In the afternoon, at four, I go to the park.

blocks.es: Me siento en un banco de madera.
blocks.en: I sit on a wooden bench.
I breathe.
I relax my shoulders.

blocks.es: Después del trabajo, descanso un poco.
blocks.en: After work, I rest a little.
Today is Thursday.
It is half past ten.
I go to the market.

blocks.es: Compro [[tomate|tomates]], un pepino y un pimiento rojo.
blocks.en: I buy tomatoes, a cucumber, and a red pepper.

blocks.es: Los pongo en mi bolsa de tela.
blocks.en: I put them in my cloth bag.
I am going to cook at home.

blocks.es: Por la tarde, [[preparar|preparo]] una ensalada simple.
blocks.en: In the afternoon, I make a simple salad.
Tomato, cucumber and pepper.

blocks.es: Mi piso ya parece mi casa.
blocks.en: My flat already feels like home.
I am focused.
Today is Friday.

blocks.es: Son las cuatro de la tarde.
blocks.en: It is four in the afternoon.
I go to a café in my neighbourhood.

blocks.es: Es la primera vez en esta cafetería.
blocks.en: It is the first time in this café.

blocks.es: Pido un café y leo un libro.
blocks.en: I order a coffee and read a book.
I feel comfortable here.
Today is Saturday.
It is 10 in the morning.
I go to Retiro Park.
I walk by the lake.

blocks.es: Veo el agua y los árboles.
blocks.en: I see the water and the trees.
Madrid has a lot of green.
I enjoy the weekend.
Today is Sunday.
It is 10 in the morning.
I tidy my flat.
The boxes are gone.

blocks.es: Pongo la planta junto a la [[ventana|ventana]].
blocks.en: I put the plant by the window.

blocks.es: El piso está limpio y cómodo.
blocks.en: The flat is clean and comfortable.

blocks.es: Por la tarde me siento con un café.
blocks.en: In the afternoon I sit with a coffee.
I look out the window.

blocks.es: La planta está en el alféizar.
blocks.en: The plant is on the windowsill.

blocks.es: En Madrid empiezo a sentirme como en casa.
blocks.en: In Madrid, I am beginning to feel at home.

blocks.es: Esta es mi semana en Madrid.
blocks.en: This is my week in Madrid.
